spec.why: Review plans, documentation and code diffs in the Wukong web app, submit anchored comments to a waiting coding agent, and inspect revisions through the full SDD owner workflow.

requirements.text: The system MUST review explicitly selected Markdown documents and Git code changes as immutable rounds tied to exact bytes, project, pack and baseline.

scenarios.given: an active pack and explicit document paths or code paths plus a Git baseline
scenarios.then: the UI shows the selected immutable bytes and exact diff sides; unrelated dirty files are excluded

requirements.text: The owner MUST add round, file and line-range comments bound to a target ID, snapshot digest and diff side; invalid anchors are refused.

scenarios.then: a stable thread records the original quote and byte identity; forged or invalid line ranges fail

requirements.text: Draft comments MUST stay drafts until explicit Submit feedback; submitted batches MUST have monotonic cursors and stable IDs, survive restart and be safely reread.

scenarios.given: draft comments and a waiting CLI reader
scenarios.then: one immutable batch appears; retry does not duplicate it; repeated reads do not consume it

requirements.text: Agents MUST reply to threads and publish new immutable rounds without resolving human comments; source changes retain original anchors and explicit stale status.

scenarios.given: an unresolved thread on round one
scenarios.when: an agent replies and publishes round two
scenarios.then: the owner can compare both rounds; edited/deleted anchors stay linked to the original and are never silently retargeted or cleared; stale recovery publishes a fresh round and explicit reattachment plus Submit redelivers that thread

requirements.text: Feedback MUST NOT grant spec approval, decision acceptance, Start permission, task completion, PACK PASS or Finish; changed bound artifacts require the existing replan route.

scenarios.given: a pack without Start or with a receipt for different bytes
scenarios.when: feedback is submitted or all comments are resolved
scenarios.then: the machine execution gate remains closed; a plan change cannot use the old receipt

requirements.text: Feedback writes MUST use the shared pack writer lock, held feedback revision, durable atomic publication and stable operation IDs; corruption, recovery and bounds fail explicitly.

scenarios.given: concurrent writers, a failed publication or an oversized record
scenarios.then: no false acknowledgement or partial committed round appears; retries and recovery are explicit

requirements.text: Browser feedback MUST remain loopback-only and enforce existing Host, Origin, page token, content-type, size and realpath guards; agents cannot resolve threads or write completed packs.

scenarios.given: two enrolled projects, hostile requests and completed packs
scenarios.when: a request crosses a boundary or claims the wrong role
scenarios.then: it is refused without source, store or owner-receipt mutation; permitted reads remain available

requirements.text: Claude, Codex and Pi MUST receive the same structured submitted batch through the CLI wait/read protocol and show replies/new rounds through Wukong; idle-host delivery is explicitly manual or next-prompt.

scenarios.given: a host using the feedback skill in the correct workspace
scenarios.when: the owner submits feedback while its CLI wait is active
scenarios.then: the command returns a batch and the agent reads/replies; timeout is pending, never approval; an idle host is not claimed to be awakened

requirements.text: The Feedback view MUST show document/diff selection, draft/submitted/agent-response states, original/new rounds, stale anchors, unresolved threads, conflicts, errors and unavailable-agent guidance with keyboard access.

scenarios.when: the owner reviews, submits, retries or changes round
scenarios.then: states are distinguishable and recoverable; focus, labels and keyboard navigation work; source/comment HTML stays inert

requirements.text: Feedback MUST preserve specpack 0.2/0.3/0.4 bytes and core discovery; active 0.4 enables writes, legacy and completed records get clear unsupported/read-only behavior.

scenarios.given: existing and new packs, with nested feedback records
scenarios.then: no adoption or format rewrite occurs; the canonical pack remains discoverable with exactly one root JSON

requirements.text: Delivery MUST record document and code review loops for Claude, Codex and Pi, relevant recovery checks, repository gates, current knowledge and independent PACK review before the owner finishes.

scenarios.given: the approved task sequence has completed
scenarios.then: actual host/check evidence supports claims; missing native witnesses remain blocked; separate human Finish freezes the record

out_of_scope: Browser chat or session/tool process control
Cloud sharing, phone access, remote listeners and PR hosting integration
Crit installation, embedding or copied implementation
Live-app DOM and static HTML preview review
Automatic adoption of legacy packs or permission inference
Windows native release certification in this Linux slice

constraints.text: Retain localhost enrollment, Host/Origin/page-token/realpath guards and no outbound network behavior from SECURITY.md.
Capture review artifacts and explicit comments only; no agent session, transcript, token or credential capture.
Preserve canonical workflow authority, source drift guards, approved artifacts, closed packs and historical formats.
Use the authoritative harness and canonical installer for requested Claude/Codex/Pi surface updates.
Bound snapshot bytes, round count, comment size, store size and wait duration; never silently truncate review targets.

stories.want: review precise artifact changes and carry comments across rounds
stories.so: I can guide revisions without losing the original context

stories.want: receive submitted browser feedback in Claude, Codex or Pi
stories.so: I can revise through one portable protocol

stories.want: keep feedback separate from executable authority and frozen evidence
stories.so: the full SDD journey remains accountable

decisions.decision: Keep feedback/1 state and immutable round files under the active pack feedback/ directory, separate from the canonical specpack; use the existing pack writer lock and durable atomic publication.
decisions.because: A separate file format avoids changing approved plan digests or legacy corpus bytes. SQLite adds a dependency and migration surface; putting comments in canonical JSON couples conversation to owner receipts.

decisions.decision: Use a portable CLI open/wait/read/reply/round bridge plus an installed feedback skill; bounded cursor reads deliver submitted batches, with explicit next-prompt/manual fallback for idle hosts.
decisions.because: All named hosts can run commands and read files in the reference pattern. Native RPC/SDK session control has host-specific authority, lifecycle and trust costs outside the selected scope. Real-host witnesses remain mandatory.

decisions.decision: Snapshot explicit Markdown targets and selected Git diff paths with exact content hashes, baseline commit IDs and before/after line anchors; source changes make anchors stale rather than silently moving them.
decisions.because: Live line numbers and a whole-worktree diff can misaddress edits or capture unrelated changes. Explicit immutable snapshots give an auditable referent; heuristic auto-reattachment is deferred.

decisions.decision: Keep feedback submit, agent replies and owner resolution separate from the existing spec/decision/Start/PACK/Finish workflow. Expose pending feedback without creating a hidden execution permission or automatic approval.
decisions.because: Crit-style feedback completion is insufficient for Wukong owner authority. Reusing core gates preserves frozen artifacts and makes scope drift require owner review; unresolved feedback remains visible rather than silently clearing.

decisions.decision: Add a Feedback view to the shared project-qualified Wukong library, with source line/diff anchors and existing sandboxed Markdown preview; keep legacy foreground views disabled for this feature.
decisions.because: The shared application already provides enrolled-project routing and page-token guards. Crit embedding introduces a second service and protocol; exposing new writes in the legacy foreground server would require another security surface.

designs.title: Feedback state and immutable rounds
designs.detail: Versioned nested store, revisions, operation IDs, immutable snapshots, draft/batch/reply/thread state and frozen history. Reattachment drafts are explicitly submitted on the new round; sealed rounds never require inaccessible owner action.

designs.title: Snapshot builder and portable CLI
designs.detail: Explicit artifact/Git selection, stable before/after bytes, bounded wait/read/reply/round JSON protocol.

designs.title: Guarded shared browser routes
designs.detail: Existing enrolled-project and page-token boundary; allowlisted stored snapshots and human feedback POST operations.

designs.title: Feedback browser view
designs.detail: Safe document/diff views, keyboard anchors, draft/batch/reply/stale/conflict states with separate workflow controls.

designs.title: Harness feedback skill and context
designs.detail: Shared Claude/Codex/Pi protocol, explicit wait and next-prompt fallback, current task authority and source identity checks.

designs.title: Journey and evidence
designs.detail: Actual native host loops, recovery, compatibility, repository/wiki gates and later independent review/human Finish.
